Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: replacement concept illustration for Grassy's basic melee attack, showing TWO sequential beats side by side, landscape wide image.
Use input image 1 ONLY as the identity, clothing, keyboard design, equipment and polished 3D game-art style reference. Invent new melee poses from scratch, do not keep the reference's typing or carrying pose.
Hero invariants: same cute young male Grassy with expressive huge brown eyes, layered dark brown hair, red knit sweater, rolled blue jeans, white sneakers, compact white/graphite/cyan forearm and waist tech equipment. Same chibi proportions, roughly 3.1 heads, expressive determined face. High quality sculpted 3D animation-film look with rich hair clumps, believable rounded material surfaces.
PRIMARY REQUEST: The KEYBOARD ITSELF is a SINGLE-HANDED BLUNT MELEE WEAPON, swung like a short bat or a paddle to hit an enemy. This is a physical whack, not typing, not pushing, not rubbing the enemy. Do not create guns or magic projectiles.
MANDATORY GRIP IN BOTH PANELS: ONLY his RIGHT hand holds ONE SHORT END / OUTER CORNER of the intact rectangular keyboard; palm under the short-end casing, thumb over casing, other fingers visibly curled tightly under edge. Most of the keyboard's long axis extends away from his right fist, like a paddle blade. The left hand is completely empty and visibly far away from the keyboard, counterbalancing behind or beside torso. No new handle added to keyboard. No second hand touching the keyboard. Show the grip clearly, no grip hidden by effects.
LEFT HALF, title exactly “01 单手左挥”: full-body Grassy, grounded wide stance, strongly twisted shoulders and hips. His RIGHT shoulder and arm sweep across the front of his torso in a broad follow-through to camera-left. The free LEFT arm reaches behind him for balance, clearly separate. His RIGHT fist at the keyboard near short end, keyboard extending leftward; the far outer end / corner of keyboard physically STRIKES the chest/shoulder armor of a gray humanoid enemy training robot on the far left. Robot recoils visibly backward, torso tilted, arm flung out. Main contact bright little orange sparks and a few flying armor chips, no injury. Show a large directional CRESCENT swing trail just BEHIND the keyboard marking previous path from raised wind-up to contact; not a ring around waist. Lean into the impact.
RIGHT HALF, title exactly “02 反手右挥”: same hero next beat. Keeping the SAME RIGHT HAND on keyboard's SAME short-end grip, recoil and reverse into a big BACKHAND sweep to camera-right. Torso unwinds, RIGHT arm extends far outward to right, empty LEFT hand behind the body for balance. Keyboard projects away from the right fist to camera-right; its far end strikes shoulder/upper chest armor of a second gray enemy training robot on far right. Robot knocked sideways with bent balance and impact sparks. Strong asymmetric action silhouette, clear open negative space between free left hand and weapon, no symmetrical two-handed posture.
Scene: restrained blue-gray sci-fi training floor and gradient background, no complex scenery, no jet exhaust. Robots are supporting impact targets, hero and keyboard are focal. Both hero full-body poses and BOTH ENTIRE keyboards fit inside image. Subtle vertical separation between the two beats. Upper titles crisp white and cyan Chinese typography. Give poses plenty of room.
The finite solid keyboard must look identical to reference: white/silver casing, black and gray keycaps, cyan small edge lights, rectangular with realistic long-to-short ratio about 3:1. Keep it intact, solid, not floppy or a sword. Render KEYBOARD KEYS clearly. Contact must be at its DISTAL end, not at hero's fingers. Exaggerated bodily torque and readable striking leverage, direct physical impact, game animation reference quality.
Avoid: holding two ends with two hands, typing, keyboard horizontally carried as tray, keyboard glued across chest, pushing/rubbing robot, two hands clasped, fist through keys, giant light rings obscuring grip, motion blur obscuring anatomy, extra hands, flying pose, gore, unrelated weapons, any text other than the two titles.
